project.title: California San Joaquin Valley Air Mycobiome
project.description: The goals of this study are to understand the structure and dispersal characteristics of the airborne fungal community in the California San Joaquin Valley. This data is especially useful for better understanding airborne fungal pathogens such as Coccidioides.
